lin.name: Lin Man
lin.greeting: Hey, new neighbor! Our weekend exhibition needs a name. Would you go for something lively or something quiet?

xu.name: Xu Ning
xu.greeting: Welcome to Wutong Lane. Coffee on Saturday? You could help me figure out how to hang photos by the window.

tang.name: Tang Yue
tang.greeting: Hi, I'm Tang. I'm stuck choosing photos for the exhibition. A fresh pair of eyes might help.

posts.author: lin
posts.text: Three poster drafts later, I'm taking a break. Our little exhibition still needs a name that makes a passerby want to come in and stay awhile. Ideas?

posts.author: xu
posts.text: The window wall is clear. Found six wooden frames, too. Saturday afternoon: coffee as usual, photos at your own pace. One rule—leave room for the person carrying the coffee.

posts.author: tang
posts.text: The alley after last year's rain. This photo is a little dark, but I can't let it go. Twelve photos, six spaces. Would this one make you stop for a moment?
